info.title: Crow HR API
info.description: Versioned REST API used by the Crow HR web app and native apps. Within v1, changes are additive only; see docs/api.md.

get.description: hr_admins do not see security-settings, SSO or payroll events; payroll_admins see payroll, compensation and bank events only.

get.summary: Sign-in methods an organisation has enabled
get.description: Public. Without `org`, resolves the only organisation of a single-organisation install.

post.summary: Complete a password sign-in with a TOTP or recovery code

get.description: The only cookie-authenticated GET with side effects; protected by `state`. Validates the ID token (signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce) and the provider restrictions, links or matches the identity, then signs in.

302.description: Redirect into the app, or back to the sign-in page with an error.

get.summary: Relying-party public keys for a provider (Singpass)
Start single sign-on with a provider
get.description: Redirects to the identity provider (authorization code + PKCE S256, state and nonce kept server-side for 10 minutes). `purpose=test` is an owner's test sign-in; `purpose=link` links the provider to the signed-in user.

post.summary: Set a new password from a reset link
post.description: Single use. Revokes every session and device of the user.

post.summary: Check a password reset link before showing the form
Request a password reset email
post.description: Always answers 202, whether or not the email belongs to a member.

post.summary: Confirm it's you before a sensitive action
post.description: Password sessions: password, plus a TOTP or recovery code when MFA is enrolled. SSO sessions re-authenticate by an SSO round-trip instead.

401.description: Error: invalid_credentials, invalid_mfa_code, session_expired, session_revoked, unauthenticated.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Every failure (unknown email, wrong password, suspended, locked) answers the same 401 invalid_credentials. When MFA is enrolled the response carries a pending-sign-in token instead of a session.

post.summary: Sign out of this browser session
Switch the session to another organisation you belong to
post.description: Issues a new session token (rotation) scoped to the target organisation.

get.description: Directory fields are visible to every member. Work pass state only to readers of all work passes.

post.summary: Hire an employee
post.description: Creates the employee, tenure, employment record, optional compensation (payroll roles only), onboarding checklist and sign-in invitation.

get.summary: Export the employee list (CSV or XLSX, masked identifiers)
Export with unmasked NRIC/FIN or bank numbers (requires recent sign-in)

get.description: Sections the caller may not read are omitted and listed in redactedFields.

post.summary: Set the bank account from a date (previous one kept as history)
Reveal the full current bank account number once (re-authentication, 30 per hour, audited)

post.description: transfer, promotion, salary_change, probation_confirmed, resignation, termination or rehire. Future-dated events are scheduled.

post.description: Returns a new secret and otpauth URI. Enrolment completes only after a valid code is confirmed.

Reset a member's two-step verification
post.description: Owner only. The member enrols again at next sign-in (subject to the MFA policy).

post.summary: Generate a one-time password reset link for a member
post.description: For installs without email. Shown once; valid 60 minutes. hr_admins can do this only for members without assigned roles.

post.summary: Reactivate a suspended member

put.description: Owner only. Takes effect on the member's next request. The last active owner cannot lose the owner role.

get.summary: Sign-in methods, MFA policy and session timeouts

patch.description: Password sign-in can be turned off only once an SSO method is enabled and has passed a test sign-in. Owners keep break-glass password sign-in.

get.description: 200 while the install has no organisation; 404 once setup is complete.

post.summary: Complete first-run setup
post.description: Creates the organisation and its owner in one transaction, invalidates the setup code and signs the owner in (MFA enrolment is offered next). Requires the code in the `x-setup-code` header.

post.summary: Check the one-time setup code
post.description: Send the code from the server logs in the `x-setup-code` header. Five wrong codes from one IP block it for 15 minutes.

get.description: Version, database and migration state, last backup, disk space, and how this request reached the server (client IP, scheme, trusted proxy). Owners only; read-only.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Switch on this, never on the message.
